name: one-way-optimal-language
description: Draft, review, or rewrite medical, dental, pharmacy, or research text that readers use without a chance to ask questions — policies, SOPs, ethics codes, guidelines, clinical notes, patient handouts, labels, consent forms, HIPAA and other notices, portal messages — for plain language, reading level, ambiguity, and Ken Adams (MSCD) style, with every clause in active voice.
